title: Vigilante #8 DC 1984 Return of the Electrocutioner Marv Wolfman Ross Andru
condition_description: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
Vigilante #8 (July 1984), DC Comics - "The Return of the Electrocutioner!" Written by Marv Wolfman, art by Ross Andru and Mike DeCarlo; cover by Ross Andru and Romeo Tanghal. Baxter paper, $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: SportsNow magazine ad (The Ripkens of Baltimore).

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
